preconditions.description: The number of computers is between 1 and 1500, inclusive.
The difficulty values are between 0 and the maximum possible value, inclusive.
The difficulty between a computer and itself is 0.

preconditions.expression: a_i_j > 0 for all 1 <= i < j <= n
preconditions.description: The difficulty between any two distinct computers is positive.

preconditions.expression: a_i_j == a_j_i for all 1 <= i, j <= n
all a_i_j for i < j are different
preconditions.description: All difficulties between distinct computers are unique.

postconditions.expression: output[k] is the number of ways to divide computers into k groups, modulo 998244353
postconditions.description: The output for each k is the number of valid groupings modulo 998244353.
